constraints: Must be called before WEB SERVICE CALL for the authentication information to be applied to the next request; it configures state consumed by the following WEB SERVICE CALL, it does not perform the call itself.

protocolRefs.multiCallChain: Web Services (Client) SOAP call sequence: WEB SERVICE AUTHENTICATE (optional) and/or WEB SERVICE SET OPTION (optional) configure per-call client state -> WEB SERVICE SET PARAMETER is called once per request parameter to build the SOAP message -> WEB SERVICE CALL sends the request (consuming the authenticate/option/parameter state and erasing any previous result) -> WEB SERVICE GET RESULT retrieves each returned value (pass '*' on the final call to free memory) -> on error, WEB SERVICE Get info can be called from an ON ERR CALL method to inspect the SOAP fault.

overloadMerges.note: Restored sentinelValues on authMethod (0/1/2 documented constants) and on the trailing '*' symbol parameter, which autoparse leaves as an opaque literal_symbols param with no documented meaning attached.

params.name: authMethod
params.description: Authentication method to use for the next WEB SERVICE CALL

sentinelValues.meaning: Not specified/omitted: 4D negotiates the method automatically (sends an additional request)

params.description: If passed, indicates the authentication information must be sent to an HTTP proxy rather than the target server

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Registers the name/password credentials (and optional authentication method / proxy flag) to be encoded into the HTTP request sent by the next WEB SERVICE CALL.
